title: Game Template
about: A starter Rust + Macroquad game wired to macroquad-toolkit for UI, save/load, data loading, notifications, grid helpers, and camera controls.

controls.desc: Select a map tile or use the action and save buttons
Pan, Zoom - / Zoom +, and Reset the view
Stop or resume energy and actions; Escape also toggles pause
Alternative map pan and zoom controls
Alternative to tapping the first action card
